actions.limitations: Current autonomous systems struggle with non-convex objective landscapes; reliance on simple scalarization limits the diversity and reliability of self-generated research questions.
actions.next_questions: How can autonomous agents dynamically learn or discover non-convex reward scalarization methods to better identify complex, research-worthy objectives?
actions.reason: Revision incorporating limitations of convex scalarization as a constraint on autonomous inquiry.
actions.summary: Autonomous open-ended discovery leverages intrinsic curiosity for bootstrapping exploration. However, current frameworks often rely on convex scalarization assumptions which may fail in complex, non-convex landscapes typical of real-world research problems. Incorporating non-convex constraint awareness is critical for robust problem identification.
